name: Feature Flags Extensions
description: Extends the Feature Flags module so a feature flag can gate routes and permissions, plus a Twig function to test a flag's state in templates.
project_description: Add-on for the Feature Flags (featureflags) module (requires drupal/featureflags ^2.0, Drupal 11). It lets each feature flag control two additional things and exposes a template helper. (1) Route gating: two adjacent-tab forms are added to every feature flag (RoutesForm at /admin/structure/feature-flags/manage/{featureflag}/routes and PermissionsForm at .../permissions, both gated by the base module's 'administer featureflag entities' permission). The Routes form saves a newline-separated list of route machine names into a 'featureflags_routes' config entity keyed by the flag id; a route event subscriber (RouteSubscriber) reads those entities and, for every flag whose state is OFF, sets requirement _access = FALSE on each listed route so the route becomes unavailable while the flag is off. (2) Permission gating: the Permissions form saves a set of selected permission ids into a 'featureflags_permissions' config entity; a decorator of core's permission_checker service (PermissionChecker) returns FALSE for any of those permissions while the owning flag is OFF. (3) A Twig extension registers a featureflag_active(flag_id) function returning FeatureFlag::isActive(). Two config entity types (featureflags_permissions, featureflags_routes) provide standard admin CRUD (collection/add/edit/delete) gated by 'administer featureflags_extensions_permissions' / 'administer featureflags_extensions_routes'; both entities export to config so bindings travel through the normal deployment workflow. The module ships no settings form of its own (configure is null); flag bindings are edited on each flag. It has no external HTTP, credentials or Drush commands.
